meta.name: Superwog - Miniseries
meta.description: Superwog and Johnny are back for more action in this new YouTube miniseries.

videos.title: The Wingman
videos.overview: Superwog tries to score a date with Vikki, and asks his mate Johnny to help him out

videos.title: The Cool Guy
videos.overview: Superwog meets an old bully from high school.

videos.title: The iPhone
videos.overview: Superwog applies for welfare so he can use the money to buy an iPhone.

videos.title: The Jacket
videos.overview: Superwog donates one of his dad's old jackets to charity. But when he finds out the jacket he sold was worth a lot of money, he becomes dead-set on getting it back, so he can then sell it for himself.

videos.title: The Rebound
videos.overview: Superwog meets a girl who recently broke up with her boyfriend, and agrees to be her rebound.

videos.title: The Virus
videos.overview: Johnny invites Max over to his house after hearing he got dumped by his girlfriend. But Superwog doesn't like this unexpected visit, and things start to go south.

videos.title: The Garbo
videos.overview: Superwog confronts a garbageman about him leaving one of his bins laying on the ground, and seeks to find out why they slightly inconvenience people like that.

videos.title: The Window Table
videos.overview: Superwog tries to get a seat at the table next to the window in his favourite Japanese restaurant.

videos.title: The Vandalism
videos.overview: Superwog and Johnny vandalise some construction worker's plans by spray painting over them, and get into big trouble.
